title: claim refuses the orchestrator's own claims for its subagents in its checkout
goal: ST-ov6h4gbx's checkout guard keys a session on --by, so the documented kb-sprint run step (the orchestrator claims up to four items in its own checkout as claim ID --by <subagent name>, then pushes the claims once) is refused from the second claim on. The guard keys the session on CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID, which Claude Code sets in every Bash subprocess (kb: claude/hooks, S745), falling back to --by where it is unset: one session claims for several names in its checkout, and a second session there is still refused. Found by the SP-gfz3rl64 review.
